unitsData.title: Me, Myself, and I
unitsData.subject: Formation personnelle et sociale
unitsData.description: Discovering personal identity, strengths, feelings, and self-awareness. Building foundation for personal growth and self-care.
unitsData.bigIdeas: I am unique and special. Understanding myself helps me grow and learn.
unitsData.essentialQuestions: ["Qui suis-je?","Qu'est-ce qui me rend unique?","Comment puis-je prendre soin de moi?"]
unitsData.assessmentPlan: Self-reflection journals, personal strength inventories, feeling identification activities, self-portrait assessments.
unitsData.differentiationStrategies: {"emerging":"Visual feeling cards, supported self-reflection, concrete examples","developing":"Independent journaling, peer sharing, goal setting","extending":"Complex emotion exploration, mentoring others, leadership opportunities"}
unitsData.culminatingTask: Create an "All About Me" portfolio showcasing personal identity, strengths, and growth.

unitsData.title: Healthy Me
unitsData.subject: Formation personnelle et sociale
unitsData.description: Learning about personal health practices including hygiene, nutrition, sleep, and physical activity for overall wellness.
unitsData.bigIdeas: Healthy habits help us feel good and grow strong. We can make choices that keep us healthy.
unitsData.essentialQuestions: ["Comment puis-je garder mon corps en santé?","Quelles habitudes m'aident à me sentir bien?","Pourquoi la santé est-elle importante?"]
unitsData.assessmentPlan: Healthy habits tracking charts, hygiene routine demonstrations, nutrition choice activities, wellness goal setting.
unitsData.differentiationStrategies: {"emerging":"Visual routine cards, hands-on practice, simple choices","developing":"Habit tracking, peer modeling, goal setting","extending":"Research projects, teaching others, family wellness plans"}
unitsData.culminatingTask: Design a "Healthy Day" plan showing good health practices from morning to night.
lessonPlanTitles: Healthy Living: Healthy Foods - Unit: Healthy Me...
Healthy Living: Drinking Water - Unit: Healthy Me...
Healthy Living: Healthy Habits - Unit: Healthy Me...

unitsData.title: Safe and Sound
unitsData.subject: Formation personnelle et sociale
unitsData.description: Understanding safety practices at home, school, and in the community. Learning about personal safety and responsibility.
unitsData.bigIdeas: Safety rules help protect us. We can make safe choices and help others stay safe too.
unitsData.essentialQuestions: ["Comment puis-je rester en sécurité?","Quelles sont les règles de sécurité importantes?","Comment puis-je aider les autres à être en sécurité?"]
unitsData.assessmentPlan: Safety rule demonstrations, emergency procedure practice, safe choice scenarios, responsibility reflections.
unitsData.differentiationStrategies: {"emerging":"Visual safety signs, role play practice, buddy system","developing":"Safety scenarios, problem-solving, peer teaching","extending":"Safety leadership roles, creating safety materials, mentoring"}
unitsData.culminatingTask: Create a safety guide for home and school with important rules and procedures.

unitsData.title: Friends and Feelings
unitsData.subject: Formation personnelle et sociale
unitsData.description: Developing healthy relationships, understanding emotions, practicing empathy, and resolving conflicts peacefully.
unitsData.bigIdeas: Healthy friendships make us happy. We can understand and manage our feelings and help others with theirs.
unitsData.essentialQuestions: ["Comment être un bon ami?","Comment gérer mes sentiments?","Comment résoudre les conflits pacifiquement?"]
unitsData.assessmentPlan: Friendship skills observations, emotion regulation strategies, conflict resolution role plays, empathy activities.
unitsData.differentiationStrategies: {"emerging":"Social scripts, visual emotion cards, supported interactions","developing":"Peer problem-solving, emotion journals, friendship goals","extending":"Peer mediation, emotion mentoring, complex social situations"}
unitsData.culminatingTask: Friendship fair showcasing healthy relationship skills and emotion management strategies.
lessonPlanTitles: Friends & Feelings: Being a Good Friend
Friends & Feelings: Sharing and Taking Turns
Friends & Feelings: Helping Others Feel Better

unitsData.title: Growing and Learning
unitsData.subject: Formation personnelle et sociale
unitsData.description: Recognizing personal growth, developing learning skills, setting goals, and building confidence for future challenges.
unitsData.bigIdeas: We grow and learn every day. Setting goals helps us improve and celebrating growth builds confidence.
unitsData.essentialQuestions: ["Comment ai-je grandi cette année?","Quelles sont mes forces d'apprentissage?","Quels sont mes objectifs pour le futur?"]

unitsData.title: Our Wonderful World

unitsData.description: Celebrating our classroom community, reflecting on relationships, and preparing for summer with health and safety awareness.
